purpose: Verify employee successfully submits a valid leave application with substitute nomination
preconditions: Active employee with sufficient balance, valid dates, and eligible substitute
action_or_input: Submit leave application for CL with substitute nominated
expected_result: Leave application created with status PENDING_SUBSTITUTE

purpose: Verify employee successfully applies for leave with embedded station leave details
preconditions: Active employee applying for leave with outstation travel
action_or_input: Submit leave request with station leave address and contact details
expected_result: Application created with station leave details coupled to the same record

purpose: Verify application rejection when applicant has insufficient leave balance
preconditions: Employee has 0 days balance in requested category
action_or_input: Submit leave application
expected_result: Submission blocked with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to insufficient balance

purpose: Verify application rejection when dates overlap with an active existing leave
preconditions: Employee has active leave on requested dates
action_or_input: Submit overlapping leave application
expected_result: Submission blocked with 422 Unprocessable Entity due to date collision

purpose: Verify application rejection when nominated substitute is ineligible or self-nominated
preconditions: Applicant nominates self or employee currently on leave
action_or_input: Submit leave application with invalid substitute
expected_result: Submission blocked with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify nominated substitute accepts the request and forwards to Unit Head
preconditions: Leave request in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE state
action_or_input: Nominated substitute consents/accepts request
expected_result: Substitute status set to ACCEPTED and request advances to PENDING_APPROVAL

purpose: Verify nominated substitute declines request and notifies applicant to renominate
preconditions: Leave request in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE state
action_or_input: Nominated substitute declines request with reason
expected_result: Substitute status set to DECLINED; applicant notified to re-nominate

purpose: Verify Unit Head approves CL/RH request as final authority
preconditions: CL request in PENDING_APPROVAL assigned to Unit Head
action_or_input: Unit Head approves the request
expected_result: Request status transitions to APPROVED/SANCTIONED and balance is debited

purpose: Verify Unit Head recommends EL/COL/VL/SCL request to higher sanctioning authority
preconditions: EL request in PENDING_APPROVAL assigned to Unit Head
action_or_input: Unit Head recommends request
expected_result: Request status transitions to PENDING_HIGHER_SANCTION

purpose: Verify Unit Head rejects leave request with recorded remarks
preconditions: Request in PENDING_APPROVAL assigned to Unit Head
action_or_input: Unit Head rejects request with rejection remarks
expected_result: Request status transitions to REJECTED and applicant balance lock is released

purpose: Verify Establishment Admin verifies admissibility of higher-sanction leave
preconditions: Leave in PENDING_HIGHER_SANCTION awaiting administrative verification
action_or_input: Establishment admin records admissibility verification check
expected_result: Verification logged in action history and request advances to Sanctioning Authority

purpose: Verify higher sanctioning authority (Director/Dean) grants final approval
preconditions: Request recommended and pending higher sanction
action_or_input: Sanctioning authority approves the request
expected_result: Request transitions to SANCTIONED/APPROVED and balance officially debited

purpose: Verify higher sanctioning authority rejects request
preconditions: Request pending higher sanction
action_or_input: Sanctioning authority rejects the request with comments
expected_result: Request transitions to REJECTED and balance reservation is restored

purpose: Verify modification of submitted request is prohibited per adjudication G-09 & BR-EL-034
preconditions: Leave request already submitted
action_or_input: Attempt to edit submitted request fields in-place
expected_result: Action rejected with 405 Method Not Allowed or 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify applicant withdraws pending leave request prior to final sanction
preconditions: Leave request is currently pending (substitute or approval)
action_or_input: Applicant submits withdrawal action
expected_result: Status transitions immediately to WITHDRAWN; balance hold is cleared

purpose: Verify applicant cannot withdraw an already approved leave request
preconditions: Leave request is already in SANCTIONED/APPROVED status
action_or_input: Applicant attempts withdrawal
expected_result: Action refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity (must use cancellation instead)

purpose: Verify applicant requests cancellation of approved leave before commencement date
preconditions: Approved leave with start date in future
action_or_input: Applicant submits cancellation request with reason
expected_result: Cancellation request created and routed to sanctioning authority

purpose: Verify sanctioning authority approves cancellation and restores leave balance
preconditions: Cancellation request pending review
action_or_input: Sanctioning authority approves cancellation
expected_result: Leave transitions to CANCELLED and deducted days are credited back to balance

purpose: Verify cancellation is refused once leave period has already commenced
preconditions: Leave start date is in past or current date
action_or_input: Applicant attempts cancellation of ongoing/past leave
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify applicant can request extension of ongoing EL/COL/VL before ongoing leave concludes
preconditions: Ongoing approved EL/COL/VL; sufficient additional balance
action_or_input: Applicant submits extension request with extended end date
expected_result: Extension created and routed for recommendation/approval

purpose: Verify extension request is prohibited for Casual Leave
preconditions: Ongoing approved Casual Leave (CL)
action_or_input: Submit extension request for CL
expected_result: Request refused with 422 Unprocessable Entity

purpose: Verify employee submits duty resumption upon return from sanctioned leave on expected date
preconditions: Employee completed sanctioned leave period
action_or_input: Submit duty resumption report with joining date and session (FN/AN)
expected_result: Resumption report created with status PENDING_REVIEW

purpose: Verify employee submits early duty resumption before leave scheduled end date
preconditions: Ongoing sanctioned leave; employee returns before end date
action_or_input: Submit early resumption report specifying earlier return date
expected_result: Early resumption recorded and flagged for balance credit upon verification

purpose: Verify late resumption flags overdue period for regularization
preconditions: Sanctioned leave ended; employee reports back days later
action_or_input: Submit late resumption report
expected_result: Resumption accepted and flagged as late resumption requiring regularization

purpose: Verify Unit Head reviews and accepts duty resumption report
preconditions: Resumption report in PENDING_REVIEW state
action_or_input: Unit Head approves resumption report
expected_result: Resumption approved; leave record closed; unavailed days credited back if early

purpose: Verify employee can view their current leave balances and transaction history
preconditions: Authenticated employee with leave account
action_or_input: Fetch leave balance summary and application history via API
expected_result: Returns 200 OK with accurate category balances, pending counts, and history records

purpose: Verify unauthenticated request cannot access leave balance data
preconditions: Anonymous request without session/token
action_or_input: Call leave balance endpoint
expected_result: Request refused with 401 Unauthorized

purpose: Verify user can retrieve complete exportable details/printable format for an application
preconditions: Valid leave application exists
action_or_input: Fetch printable application view/export endpoint
expected_result: Returns 200 OK with all application fields, approval history, and timestamps

purpose: Verify Admin can update leave entitlement and policy parameters
preconditions: User holds Admin/Establishment role
action_or_input: Update annual CL quota or max carry-forward limit
expected_result: Returns 200 OK and updated policy parameters take effect

purpose: Verify non-admin cannot modify policy parameters
preconditions: Standard employee without admin privileges
action_or_input: Attempt to update leave policy configuration
expected_result: Request refused with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify Admin creates and publishes annual holiday and restricted holiday calendar
preconditions: Authorized Admin user
action_or_input: Create holiday entries and publish calendar for calendar year
expected_result: Holiday entries published and accessible for leave calculations

purpose: Verify Admin records offline sanctioned leave with order reference and approver
preconditions: Authorized Admin user recording offline paperwork approval
action_or_input: Submit offline sanction record with employee ID, leave type, dates, reference number
expected_result: Offline record created, employee balance debited, audit history logged

purpose: Verify Admin can list and search leave applications across departments
preconditions: Authorized Admin user
action_or_input: Query all leave records with department/status filters
expected_result: Returns 200 OK with filtered list of leave requests

purpose: Verify Admin configures reminder and escalation SLA thresholds in hours
preconditions: Authorized Admin user
action_or_input: Configure reminder threshold=48h, escalation threshold=96h
expected_result: Thresholds saved successfully and returned in config query

purpose: Verify applicant nominates a new substitute after previous nominee declined
preconditions: Leave request currently in PENDING_SUBSTITUTE with declined substitute
action_or_input: Applicant submits replacement substitute ID
expected_result: Substitute updated to new employee; status remains PENDING_SUBSTITUTE for new consent

purpose: Verify Admin or automated process triggers year-end rollover (CL lapse, VL-to-EL conversion, EL capping)
preconditions: Calendar year end reached; employees have remaining balances
action_or_input: Trigger year-end processing job
expected_result: CL lapsed to 0, VL converted to EL at 2:1 up to 300 days cap, audit logs written

purpose: Verify system scans pending tasks and creates reminders/escalations for overdue items
preconditions: Pending task exceeds reminder or escalation threshold
action_or_input: Trigger SLA scan process
expected_result: Overdue tasks identified and corresponding SLA notifications dispatched
